description: Add Linux host…: over SSH, installs or upgrades `vibed` on the server (static binaries and a systemd user service, with lingering on so it runs while you're logged out), checks `git`, `gh` and `claude` there, records the host under its name and starts its link. `missing` lists what the server still needs, and `notes` what the owner should know. The server's logins stay its own.

notes: Lingering is on for you on me@vps.example.com, so vibed runs when you're logged out and starts again after a reboot.
